§a[Tier 6 LuV] Ultimate Compressed Mega Processing Factory§r
123T's core flagship machine - the Ultimate Compressed Mega Processing Factory.
Integrates 15 industrial processing modes (use a screwdriver to switch category; use programmed circuits 20/21/22 to switch internal mode):
  Metal class: Compressor, Lathe, Polarizer
  Fluid class: Fermenter, Fluid Extractor, Extractor
  Misc  class: Laser Engraver, Autoclave, Fluid Solidifier
  Isa   class: ISA Mill, Industrial Flotation Cell, Vacuum Drying Furnace
  Col   class: Molecular Transformer, Brewery, Fluid Heater
Parallel formula: each voltage-tier increase reduces parallel by 2, minimum 9, default 256.
